CVE-2026-119718.title: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap buffer ...
CVE-2026-119718.description: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability caused by integer overflow in ptcache_data_alloc() when reading point cache files. Attackers can supply a crafted point cache file with a large totpoint value alongside a .blend file to crash Blender or execute code as the user.

CVE-2026-119719.title: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap buffer ...
CVE-2026-119719.description: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the blend file thumbnail extractor caused by 32-bit integer overflow in thumb_data_vertical_flip(). Attackers can craft a .blend file with malicious TEST block dimensions that trigger an out-of-bounds write when blender-thumbnailer or the Windows shell extension previews it, causing crashes or code execution.

CVE-2026-119720.title: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap out-of ...
CVE-2026-119720.description: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in read_file_dna() that reads a GLOB block field without validating its declared length. Attackers can supply a crafted .blend file with a truncated GLOB block that, when opened, triggers the out-of-bounds read and crashes Blender.

CVE-2026-119721.title: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains an out-of-bou ...
CVE-2026-119721.description: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in blo_bhead_id_* accessors in readfile.cc that read ID fields without block length checks. Attackers can supply a crafted .blend file with short ID blocks that, when browsed or appended from, causes heap over-reads leading to crashes or heap memory disclosure.

CVE-2026-119722.title: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap out-of ...
CVE-2026-119722.description: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds access vulnerability in read_struct() that skips size validation when a .blend file's SDNA struct layout compares equal. Attackers can supply a crafted .blend file with short blocks so field reads, writes, and pointer dereferences overrun heap memory, causing crashes or code execution.

CVE-2026-60103.title: Blender 3.0.0 through 5.1.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulner ...
CVE-2026-60103.description: Blender 3.0.0 through 5.1.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that allows attackers to trigger a crash or read adjacent heap memory by supplying a crafted .blend file with a malicious signed short member_index value in the SDNA block. The member_index field is used as an array index into the sdna->members[] array in sdna_expand_names() without bounds validation, allowing any value outside the allocated range to produce an invalid pointer subsequently passed to strlen(), resulting in a SIGSEGV crash or unintended heap memory disclosure.
